app.name: Imaa
app.tagline: Control your computer with a wave of your hand or a nod of your head — privately.
nav.head: Head gestures
state.stopped_d: Press the button to start watching for gestures.
state.running_d: Gestures are on. Pause any time with {hotkey}.
state.paused_d: Gestures are ignored until you resume (or make the 🤘 sign).
error.camera_unavailable: The camera could not be opened. Close other apps that use it (Zoom, Teams, Camera) or pick another camera in Settings.
error.camera_lost: The camera stopped sending pictures. Check that it is connected, then start again.
error.engine_failed: Gesture detection stopped unexpectedly. Start again; if it keeps happening, try a lower resolution.
home.title: Welcome back
home.subtitle: Start Imaa, then use your hands or head to control the app in front.
home.auto_profile: Using “{profile}” for the app in front.
home.preview_off: The preview appears here when Imaa is running.
home.preview_hidden: Preview hidden to save power. Gestures still work.
home.low_light: Low light: turn on a lamp for better tracking
home.q_air_d: Your index finger moves the cursor, pinch to click
home.q_headptr_d: Your head moves the cursor, open your mouth to click
home.q_hud_d: Show a small bubble when an action happens
home.q_practice_d: See which gesture is recognised without triggering anything
home.activity_empty: Nothing yet. Try a 👍 thumbs up to raise the volume.
home.action_failed: This action could not be completed
home.privacy: Your camera picture is processed on this device only. Nothing is recorded, saved or sent anywhere.
g.thumb_up.how: Make a fist with your thumb pointing up. Hold to keep going.
g.thumb_down.how: Make a fist with your thumb pointing down. Hold to keep going.
g.point_right.how: Point your index finger to the right, other fingers folded.
g.point_left.how: Point your index finger to the left, other fingers folded.
g.pinch.how: Quickly touch your thumb and index fingertips, then open.
g.index_up_move_up.how: Raise your index finger, then move your hand up. Further = faster.
g.index_up_move_down.how: Raise your index finger, then move your hand down. Further = faster.
g.pinch_drag_up.how: Pinch and hold for a moment, then move up.
g.pinch_drag_down.how: Pinch and hold for a moment, then move down.
g.swipe_right.how: Move your open hand quickly to the right.
g.swipe_left.how: Move your open hand quickly to the left.
g.victory.how: Index and middle fingers up in a V, others folded.
g.call.how: Thumb and little finger out, like holding a phone.
g.fist.how: Close your hand into a fist, thumb tucked in.
g.rock.how: Index and little finger up. Hold a little longer — it's a safety gesture.
g.three.how: Index, middle and ring fingers up.
g.nod.how: A quick nod down and back up.
g.shake.how: Shake your head left and right, like saying “no”.
g.tilt_right.how: Tilt your head towards your right shoulder and hold.
g.tilt_left.how: Tilt your head towards your left shoulder and hold.
g.look_up.how: Lift your chin a little and hold. Repeats while held.
g.look_down.how: Lower your chin a little and hold. Repeats while held.
g.turn_right.how: Turn your head to your right and hold.
g.turn_left.how: Turn your head to your left and hold.
g.mouth_open.how: Open your mouth for a moment.
g.smile.how: Give a big smile for a moment.
g.brows_up.how: Raise both eyebrows for a moment.
hud.mic_unsupported: Can't control the microphone on this system
hud.skip_ad_no_helper: No skip button found — install the browser helper
hud.shortcut_missing: No shortcut set for this gesture
hand.title: Hand gestures
hand.subtitle: Choose what each gesture does. Changes apply instantly.
hand.enable_d: Turn off to save power if you only use head gestures.
hand.hold_d: Left = faster reaction, right = fewer accidental triggers.
hand.scroll_d: How fast the page moves with ☝️ index-up scrolling.
hand.swipe_d: Quick open-hand swipes left and right.
hand.air_d: Replaces hand gestures with cursor control. 🤘 still pauses.
head.title: Head gestures
head.subtitle: Hands-free control: nod, shake, tilt, turn — and facial expressions in Accurate mode.
head.enable_d: Works together with hand gestures, or on its own.
head.mode_d: Light uses the least power. Accurate adds mouth, smile and eyebrows.
head.sensitivity_d: Higher = smaller head movements are enough.
head.hold_d: How long to hold a tilt, turn or look before it fires.
head.pointer_d: Turn your head to move the cursor. Open mouth = click, raise eyebrows = right click.
head.recalibrate_tip: Look straight at the screen and press to set your neutral head position.
gestures.enable_tip: Turn this gesture on or off
profile.general.d: Everyday use: volume, media, scrolling, tabs.
profile.presentation.d: Slides move with pointing or head tilts; pinch blanks the screen. Turns on for PowerPoint, Keynote, Impress and PDF readers.
profile.media.d: Media keys for players and streaming. Turns on for VLC, Spotify, Music and more.
profile.browser.d: Pointing goes back and forward in history.
profile.meeting.d: Quick mic toggle for calls. Turns on for Zoom, Teams, Webex, Slack and Discord.
profiles.title: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: Different gestures for different apps. Imaa can switch automatically.
profiles.auto_d: Use a profile when one of its apps is in front; otherwise use the selected one.
profiles.apps_d: Process names, separated by commas (for example: chrome, firefox).
profiles.name: Profile name
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Make Imaa yours.
settings.language_d: The whole app switches immediately, including right-to-left layout for Arabic.
settings.theme_d: System follows your computer's light or dark mode.
settings.login_d: Imaa starts quietly in the tray.
settings.autostart_d: Turn on the camera right away.
settings.minimized_d: Don't show the window at start-up.
settings.tray: Keep running when the window is closed
settings.tray_d: Closing the window hides it; quit from the tray icon.
settings.resolution_d: Lower uses less power. 640 × 480 is plenty for gestures.
settings.power_d: How often Imaa looks. It also rests automatically when nobody is in view.
settings.mirror_d: Point right to go right, like a mirror.
settings.skeleton_d: Show the hand skeleton and face points on the preview.
settings.sounds_d: A soft tick when an action happens.
settings.bridge_d: Lets the 'Skip ad' gesture press skip buttons in Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox. Local only.
settings.bridge_steps:
1. Open your browser's extensions page (chrome://extensions or about:debugging).
2. Turn on Developer mode.
3. Choose “Load unpacked” and select the browser-extension folder that just opened.

The helper only talks to Imaa on this computer.
settings.bridge_error: The helper port is busy. Change it or restart Imaa.
settings.bridge_waiting: Waiting for a browser with the helper installed.
settings.remote: Use my phone as a remote camera
settings.remote_d: The Imaa phone app recognises gestures and sends only the gesture name over your Wi-Fi — never video.
settings.remote_error: Couldn't open the network port. Another app may be using it.
settings.privacy_text: Imaa looks at your camera only while it is running, and only on this device. Pictures are analysed in memory and immediately discarded — nothing is recorded, saved or uploaded. Imaa has no accounts, no analytics and no ads. The optional phone remote sends gesture names only, inside your own network.
settings.import_failed: That file isn't an Imaa settings file.
settings.reset_q: Reset all settings and profiles to the defaults?
about.title: About & help
about.meaning: “Imaa” (إيماءة) is Arabic for a gesture or a nod — the two ways you can talk to your computer here.
about.tip1: Face a light source; avoid a bright window behind you.
about.tip2: Keep your hand 40–100 cm from the camera, palm towards it.
about.tip3: Hold poses for a moment. Diagonal pointing is ignored on purpose.
about.tip4: Keyboard actions go to the window you clicked last — click your slides or video once.
about.tip5: Use 🤘 or the pause shortcut before talking with your hands.
about.tip6: Practice mode shows what Imaa sees without doing anything.
about.credits_text: Hand, face and expression tracking by Google MediaPipe (Apache 2.0). Interface built with Qt for Python (LGPL). Full licence texts are included with the app.

banner.mac_accessibility: macOS is blocking keyboard and mouse control. Allow Imaa under Privacy & Security → Accessibility, then restart Imaa.
banner.wayland: You're using Wayland. Some keyboard shortcuts may need X11 or the ydotool service; volume and microphone work through PulseAudio/PipeWire.
tray.hidden: Imaa is still running in the tray. Right-click the icon to quit.
onb.welcome_d: Control your computer with simple hand and head gestures. Let's set things up — it takes a minute.
onb.privacy1: The camera picture is processed on this device, in memory only.
onb.privacy2: Nothing is ever recorded, saved or uploaded.
onb.privacy3: No account, no analytics, no ads. Works offline.
onb.privacy4: You can stop or pause at any time from the app, the tray icon or a shortcut.
onb.camera_tips_d: Sit facing a light, with your hand comfortably in front of the camera. Imaa rests automatically when nobody is in view to save power.
onb.mac: On a Mac, allow Camera and Accessibility when asked (System Settings → Privacy & Security).
onb.tour_d: Hold each pose for a moment. You can change every gesture later.
onb.tour_head: Prefer hands-free? Turn on head gestures (nod, tilt, turn) from the Home page.
